task_description.overview: Check temporal data completeness of MiniSEED waveform files within a directory. If temporal gaps are detected, perform padding to ensure continuous time series while recording all missing intervals.
steps: Scan all .mseed files in the specified directory.
Group waveform traces by network, station, location, and channel.
Sort traces chronologically for each group.
Evaluate temporal continuity based on sampling rate and trace start/end times.
If no temporal gaps exist, directly save the waveform as a processed output.
If temporal gaps exist, pad missing intervals using zero or NaN padding to reconstruct continuous time series.
Record all missing time intervals, including start time, end time, and duration.
Save padded waveforms into the output directory and generate a temporal completeness report.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Check the temporal completeness of all MiniSEED files under {data_directory}. For each file: if data are continuous, save it with name {waveform_data} to the output directory. If temporal gaps exist, pad missing intervals using {padding_method} to reconstruct a continuous waveform and save with name {waveform_data}. Record the missing intervals and output a completeness summary report to {reports_data.report_file_name} with content {reports_data.report_content}.
